# The character 十 of hanzi-writer-data

`5341.json` is the file `十.json` of [hanzi-writer-data](https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data) 2.0.1, as npm
publishes it, renamed for its code point, U+5341. The browser tests of stroke writing write its module with
`writeCharacterModule` and draw its strokes.

Hanzi Writer's data is derived from [Make Me a Hanzi](https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi) and the fonts of Arphic
Technology:

- Arphic PL KaitiM GB and UKai: Copyright 1999 Arphic Technology Co., Ltd.; licensed under the Arphic Public License.
- Make Me a Hanzi: Copyright 1999 Arphic Technology Co., Ltd., copyright 2016 Shaunak Kishore; licensed under the Arphic
  Public License.

`ARPHICPL.TXT` is the license, as the package publishes it. The file is test data, and the repository holds no other
character.
